title: dng file model and source plan

commit.merge_subject: merge: dng file model and source plan

description:
B3, night research 2026-11-16 — the DNG source package's first
deliverable, new files only (no decoder integration, no shared-file
edits; composes with the merged engine/DngSequence.kt).

Part 1, docs/DNG_SOURCE_PLAN.md (review-pending, the owner reads it):
- the decoder decision matrix: LibRaw (LGPL-2.1/CDDL dual license,
  untried NDK build, full IN-08 camera coverage) vs a hand-rolled
  minimal reader (the committed model is its metadata half) vs defer.
  Recommendation: hand-rolled first wave, LibRaw as its own later
  wave for CR2/CR3/RAF/NEF/ARW — the A-priority features (IN-09
  sequence, IN-10 photo import) need only DNG.
- the supported subset: the 23-tag minimum honest set (10 required),
  uncompressed single-strip CFA/LinearRaw, 8-16 bit; out-of-subset
  files are honest rejections with a named cause, never misreads.
- the adapter contract: the exact DngFileMetadata -> RawMeta
changed: dng: pure file metadata model + source plan
